abstract: Connect Cursor to self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoints (vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LiteLLM, llama-swap). Covers the Override OpenAI Base URL setting, why the endpoint must be public HTTPS because Cursor's servers make the request, scoped key handling, model-name mapping, tool-calling and streaming requirements, billing and data notes, troubleshooting, and a read-only probe script.
